assets.prompt: Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Match an editorial natural-history teaching collection. TRUE transparent alpha outside the object, no painted paper rectangle, no checkerboard. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, brands or labels. Include text, numbers or arrows only if the individual asset brief explicitly requires them. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: 1. `hms-health-reports-stack-v1.png`: a neat stack of five thick printed reports with plain coloured covers (teal, blue, olive, sand, grey), one lying open showing indistinct charts and tables (no readable text), a yellow sticky tab on one. No logos.
assets.scope: HMS Module 1 or Module 2 v01-v08 only
